svg.title: Abnormal uterine bleeding: vitals first, then history, exam and investigations; a visible lesion means a structural cause to remove and send to pathology, otherwise ultrasound in selected patients and the functional causes, with DUB a diagnosis of exclusion.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
